map.输入每 100g 的蛋白质、脂肪、碳水、膳食纤维与钠，自动核算能量并按 GB 2: Enter protein, fat, carbs, fiber and sodium per 100g; energy is computed and a per-100g/per-serving nutrition table with NRV% is generated.
map.营养标签按每 100 g 与每份双列标示：能量(kJ) = 蛋白质 × 17 +: The nutrition label is declared per 100 g and per serving: energy(kJ) = protein × 17 + fat × 37 + carbohydrate × 17 + dietary fiber × 8; per-serving value = per-100g value × serving weight ÷ 100; NRV% = nutrient content ÷ the NRV reference × 100% (energy 8400 kJ, protein 60 g, fat 60 g, carbohydrate 300 g, dietary fiber 25 g, sodium 2000 mg); the table follows the column order of GB 28050.
map.请至少填写一项营养素含量（g/100g）。: Enter at least one nutrient content value (g/100g).
map.按每 100g 能量/蛋白/脂肪/碳水/钠生成合规标签: Generate a label from energy, protein, fat, carbohydrate and sodium per 100 g
map.对照 NRV 标出各营养素占每日参考值: Show each nutrient's share of the daily reference value against NRV
map.预包装食品合规自查，核对标示值: Self-check prepackaged foods and verify the declared values
map.某食品每 100g：蛋白质 10g、脂肪 20g、碳水 55g、膳食纤维 2g、: A food per 100 g: protein 10g, fat 20g, carbohydrate 55g, dietary fiber 2g, sodium 300mg. Energy = 10×17 + 20×37 + 55×17 + 2×8 = 1861 kJ (444.9 kcal). NRV%: protein 16.7%, fat 33.3%, carbohydrate 18.3%, dietary fiber 8.0%, sodium 15.0%, energy 22.2%. With a 50 g serving, per-serving values are half of the above.
map.每 100g 钠 800mg → NRV% = 40%；若一天吃 250g 即占: Sodium of 800 mg per 100 g → NRV% = 40%; eating 250 g in one day reaches 100%, so high-sodium foods need portion control.
map.NRV 参考值按什么？: What are the NRV references based on?
map.按 GB 28050 预包装食品营养标签通则：能量 8400 kJ、蛋白质 60: They follow GB 28050, the general standard for nutrition labels of prepackaged foods: energy 8400 kJ, protein 60 g, fat 60 g, carbohydrate 300 g, dietary fiber 25 g, sodium 2000 mg.
map.能量(kcal) ≈ 蛋白×4 + 碳水×4 + 脂肪×9（膳食纤维常单列减算）: Energy(kcal) ≈ protein×4 + carbohydrate×4 + fat×9 (dietary fiber is usually listed and deducted separately), and the deviation from the declared value must stay within the allowed range.
map.营养（表标签）一键生成。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全。: Nutrition label generator. Free online tool, processed entirely in the browser, no data uploaded, your privacy protected.
map.某食品每 100g：能量 450 kcal、蛋白 10g、脂肪 20g、碳水 5: A food per 100 g: energy 450 kcal, protein 10 g, fat 20 g, carbs 55 g, sodium 300 mg. NRV references (energy 2000 / protein 60 / fat 60 / carbs 300 / sodium 2000): protein NRV% = 10/60 = 16.7%, fat = 20/60 = 33.3%, sodium = 300/2000 = 15%.
map.按 GB 28050 预包装食品营养标签通则：能量 2000 kcal、蛋白 6: Per GB 28050 General Rules for Nutrition Labels of Prepackaged Foods: energy 2000 kcal, protein 60 g, fat 60 g, carbs 300 g, sodium 2000 mg, etc.
map.按每 100g 的营养素含量核算能量并生成营养成分表：输出每 100g 与每份双: Calculates energy from the nutrient content per 100 g and generates a nutrition facts table: outputs dual columns for per 100 g and per serving, plus NRV%, copyable in layout; energy is computed from Atwater coefficients and is no longer randomly generated.
